items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: I played with Raymond Scott in New York, Raymond Scott's band, the studio band.

ctx.x: And maybe some nights if a guy and a gig for that night, he said, look, come on play with me and I'll give you X amount of dollars or something. I'd play that night but I wouldn't consider that working with a guy, you know. That would be just maybe a one-nighter with the guy or something. I've played with so many I couldn't even recall all the bands that I've played with like that. Just get paid for a night or a couple nights or something like that.
I played with Raymond Scott in New York, Raymond Scott's band, the studio band. Charle Shavers was on that band.
When was that that you played with Raymond?
